title: Do Large Language Models Have an English “Accent”? Evaluating and Improving the Naturalness of Multilingual LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating English-centric lexical and syntactic biases in non-English LLM outputs (French and Chinese) by measuring corpus-level divergence from native human-written texts. This is done using Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) for vocabulary distributions and Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) with Weisfeiler-Lehman graph kernels for Universal Dependencies (UD) grammar tree structures.
